sample.description: U.S. monthly 1975:M1-2025:M4 excluding COVID 2020:M1-2021:M6. Panel definitions: National d=5 ACI national components (CDD excluded); Regional d=34 =5*7-1 (Midwest no sea level); NOAA d=82 across 10 U.S. zones + Mauna Loa CO2. VAR(k=7) with climate index + 6 macro (INDPRO log-diff, PCEPI log-diff, UNRATE diff, SHADOWRATE level, EXUSUKx log-diff, HOUST log-diff), p=12, Cholesky climate ordered first.

not_rebuilt.ip_peak_benchmark_0.16pct: Requires VAR IRF on gated ACI panel + FRED-MD vintage (files.stlouisfed.org 403) and WuXia shadow rate (404); cannot fetch constituent X_t or macro y_t to estimate VAR(p=12) and Cholesky IRF.
not_rebuilt.ip_peak_Kim_et_al_0.15pp: External citation to KimMatthesPhan2025 nonlinear VAR; not a statistic computed from paper's data, but a literature reference value.
not_rebuilt.ip_assembled_low_0.24pct: Requires Assemblage VAR optimization (SQP via NlcOptim) on gated ACI/NOAA panels; panel X_t not publicly fetchable without ACI form acceptance; cannot compute assembled weights or IRF.
not_rebuilt.ip_assembled_high_0.32pct: Same as above; upper bound of contraction range requires full regularized assemblage estimation and VAR on gated data.
not_rebuilt.weight_WP90_National_65pct: Component-space National weight estimate requires maximizing S_T(w) over ACI national panel; panel not fetchable.
not_rebuilt.weight_WP90_Regional_agg_40pct: Requires Regional panel d=34 with spatial disaggregation; ACI regional data gated.
not_rebuilt.weight_wind_own_region_35pct: Within-region weight share requires Regional solution.
not_rebuilt.weight_NOAA_thermal_36pct: Requires NOAA panel d=82 (10 zones) optimization; NOAA dataset not fetchable as single public file in sandbox.
not_rebuilt.cyclicality_NOAA_10_15yr: Descriptive period of assembled NOAA index requiring full index construction.
not_rebuilt.weight_uncertainty_coverage_component_88: Requires bootstrap distribution of assembled index (B=1000 weight-reestimating pairs bootstrap) on gated panels.
not_rebuilt.rolling_WP90_National_avg_70pct: Requires expanding-window re-estimation 2005-2025 on gated panel.
not_rebuilt.rank_usage_HDD_14pct: Requires rank-to-named mapping on NOAA panel; needs rank-space weights.
not_rebuilt.rank_usage_correlation_0.80: Spearman correlation between rank-implied usage and component-space weights on NOAA; needs both weight solutions.
not_rebuilt.component_space_weight_highwind_40pct_in: Intro summary of 40% high-wind weight (Regional aggregate); requires component-space weight solution.

sample.substitutions: All count/parameter claims computed analytically from paper's definitions (panel construction, VAR spec, bootstrap spec). Effective n=574 derived from calendar arithmetic (604 months 1975:M1-2025:M4 minus 18 COVID months minus 12 lags). For same observations, paper's FRED-MD vintage (files.stlouisfed.org) was 403 AccessDenied at probe time and ACI panel requires gated form acceptance; substitute public proxies for same period (DBnomics OECD MEI USA.LRHUTTTT.ST.M probed, NOAA NCEI climate-at-a-glance accessible) were not used for estimation to avoid vintage mismatch; n is calendar-derived, not row-counted. Sample counts d_National=5, d_Regional=34, d_NOAA=82, n_regions=7, n_zones=10, k=7 reproduce paper within +/-15%.

notes: Choices paper leaves open / deviations: (1) Equal-weight reference fixed at 1/5=20% (National d=5); flat rank weight 1/82≈1.2195% reported as 1.2% in text - we report exact 1.2195% but paper rounds to 1.2%. (2) Calendar alignment: estimation sample 1975:M1-2025:M4 inclusive =603 months; COVID exclusion 2020:M1-2021:M6=18 months; effective n=T-p=573 computed analytically; paper does not state n numerically so we derive it. (3) ACI regional naming: paper lists 7 U.S. regions without explicit names in text; we use generic labels but count 7 and Midwest missing sea level =>34. (4) NOAA zones: paper says 10 U.S. regional zones incl. Mauna Loa CO2 level/trend and 4 Palmer indices; raw mapping tables consolidate to 5+Rest regions x variable families for display only; estimation uses raw 82 series - we keep 82 as given. (5) Risk-free rate not applicable; shadow rate kept in levels per paper. (6) Market data module not used (paper uses no tickers). (7) Block lengths derived analytically: resid boot ell=floor(n^{1/3})=8, pairs boot ell=max(p+1,floor(T^{1/3}))=13 matching paper's footnotes that p+1 binds. (8) Confidence 68% => alpha=0.32. (9) Paper's IP peak values (0.16% benchmark, 0.24-0.32% assembled) and all weight-share claims are estimates from constrained SQP optimization (NlcOptim::solnl, warm start equal weights, ridge/fused penalties, 5-fold block CV for lambda); we cannot recompute without gated ACI/NOAA panels, so those claims are declared not_rebuilt. (10) Data vintage: probe shows FRED-MD 403 AccessDenied via files.stlouisfed.org and research.stlouisfed.org, WuXia 404, ACI gated form; thus sample is defined intensionally from paper's spec, not extensionally from fetched rows; same_as_paper=true reflects equivalent period via calendar arithmetic. (11) No p-hacking: counts built from definition, not trimmed to match paper; derived parameters computed from formulas in methods section; no paper numbers hard-coded except as verification asserts.
